title: Killing Mr. Griffin
author: Lois Duncan
current_text: Killing Mr. Griffin was challenged in a Florida school district in 2001 after a parent objected to its “gruesome details,” but the district retained it.

sources.quote:
2001
Challenged, but retained in Florida school district because of a parent’s objection to the book’s “gruesome details”.
sources.title: Banned Books 2020 – Killing Mr. Griffin – Marshall University Libraries
